# Merge Checklist

- [ ] PR title and summary are accurate.
- [ ] Unit, integration, contract, and compliance checks passed.
- [ ] Auth, quota, and negative-path compliance layers passed.
- [ ] Coverage threshold passed.
- [ ] Complexity threshold passed.
- [ ] Migration safety checks passed.
- [ ] Helm validation passed.
- [ ] OpenAPI and proto drift checks passed.
- [ ] Swagger and Redoc routes were validated.
- [ ] Trivy, Semgrep, and secret scans are reviewed.
- [ ] Reviewer approvals are complete.
